**L1: ACCEPT** · area fleet-1 · 2026-11-19T11:32Z · head `6f40150dd0`

- **Scope:** slice 1 of #35237 (`Part of`). It adds three read-only readers: `card-pick.mjs` (new), `os-verify-lock.sh --depth` and `check-prior-rulings.mjs --paths`. Each matching procedure in `execution-duties.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md` and `coordinator.md` becomes a one-line pointer. No ratchet ceiling moves, and there is no new CI job: card-pick's self-test runs inside `check:pm-prior-rulings`.
- **L1 round 1 (fixed at this head):**
  - (1) The first head never picked a p3, which contradicts NORTH-STAR rule 3 ④ ("in an area with no sub-epic, p2 before p3"): an area holding only p3 cards came out as an empty queue. Now an area item's p3 cards rank after every p2 of that item, under the leg `order k p3 close-out`, and an epic item keeps its child order. Seven pinned cases cover this. An ablation that flips the area/epic guard turns three of them red; the blob was then restored to HEAD.
  - (2) The candidate-definition line (「开放 = 未派发…只余取卡全序。」) had been dropped as if it were procedure. It is restored byte-identical and pinned.
- **Read against main:** the reader encodes main's rule text where the scoping note differs, and the body lists each case (no triage audit excludes a card; the ungraded leg comes last; tooling's three gates are flagged, not judged). The footer names the five legs the reader cannot judge. A `Blocked-by:` target counts the way `state-machine.md` defines it on main: a line at the start of the body or a comment, and a PR target holds until it merges.
- **Gates (dev report, at this head):** card-pick self-test 54, `check:pm-prior-rulings` (173 + 54), the ratchet (`execution-duties.md` 184/189), skill-id-lint, governed-prose, nul-bytes, self-test-wired and skills-token-ratchet each exit 0. The first head's full `dispatch-gates --commands` set was 82 derived and 82 run. `overlap-check` is clean.
- **Live:** two board runs are in the body. The five picks are p1 jumps from other areas, and with `--limit 30` the area's own p2 cards are followed by its p3 close-out leg.
- **CI on this head:** still running when this record was written.

Next: seat L2 at contract tier (rule-text pointers under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**`).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6f40150dd02a2870bf9f2eb443056fa56f106159`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/coordinator.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md + scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs, scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs, scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh, package.json (the `check:pm-prior-rulings` line)
Security-touching: yes

PR #35482 (draft, `Part of #35237`), net diff against `main` `6f36818f03` (the merge base, still the tip of `main` when read). Inputs: card #35237 (body and its 4 comments), the PR body, file list and diff, and the check-runs on this head. The live board was not read and none of the three readers was run; every statement below about a reader's behaviour is read off its code at this head.

Check-runs on this head at 2026-11-19T11:43Z: 36 success, 13 skipped, 14 in progress (`Test Core`, 13 `Test UI` shards), none failed. The jobs that carry this diff's gates are complete and green: `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (runs `pnpm check:pm-prior-rulings`, so both the `check-prior-rulings` and the `card-pick` self-tests), `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` (runs `os-verify-lock.sh --self-test`), `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, both `PR-body guards`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **No published accept-set and no public surface changes.** The diff touches `scripts/pm/**`, three `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/*.md` files and one script line of the root `package.json`. No workspace package, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no `exports` map. Right.
- **Governed rule text contracts in five places; the rule content moves into three readers.** Each is judged in ④:
  - pick order (`execution-duties.md:47`, old lines 53 and 55 removed) → `card-pick.mjs`. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` "Priority" rule 3 stays the normative text and the reader pins its four clauses. Right, with S3, S4 and N1.
  - arrival depth (`execution-duties.md:19`, old lines 21-22) → `os-verify-lock.sh --depth`. The number is right; the mode's side effect is not (S1).
  - ruling-area grep and two staleness faces (`execution-duties.md:12`, old lines 12, 14, 15) → `check-prior-rulings.mjs --paths`. Wrong in its verdict line (M1) and in its zero-file case (S2).
  - the queue-empty table (`seat-lifecycle.md:89`, old lines 89-91) → `card-pick.mjs --why`. Right, with N2 and N6.
  - coordinator pick order (`coordinator.md:17`, `:27`) → `card-pick.mjs`. Line 27 is wrong for part of its population (S5).
- **Internal CLI surfaces added:** `card-pick.mjs` (exits 0, 2, 3, 4), `os-verify-lock.sh --depth` (exits 0, 1, 3), `check-prior-rulings.mjs --paths` (exit 3 on a git failure or an unresolved ref). None is a published contract.
- **CI wiring:** `check:pm-prior-rulings` now chains `card-pick.mjs --self-test`; no new job. The step ran green on this head, so the drift pins on NORTH-STAR rule 3, `execution-duties.md`, `state-machine.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md` and `dispatch-runbook.md` are gates. Right.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: nothing in the diff is published. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the claim (comment 7006559529) is right: no accept-set is widened and no public surface grows.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty on the card's report (comment 7007658675). Nothing to answer.
- Deviation (a), no triage audit excludes a card: right. `SKILL.md:180` forbids the claim, and the reader borrows `h74QueuedWithoutTriageAudit` with its fleet-card population and its parent exemption.
- Deviation (b), the ungraded leg after the named order: right against the base text (`execution-duties.md:53` on `main`). This diff removes that sentence, so the leg is now stated only in the reader (N1).
- Deviation (c): the card's report says "p3 never picks and rides after the picks". This head ranks an area's p3 as that item's close-out, after every p2 of the item and before the next item. The head's reading holds against rule 3 clause ④ ("p2 first, p3 left for the close-out"; "in an area with no sub-epic, p2 before p3").
- Deviation (d), a `tooling` card's three-gate admission is flagged, not judged: acceptable. `execution-duties.md:8` still excludes such a card, the row carries the flag and the footer names the gap.
- `not_done`, the `lanes/director.md` rider: right to decline. That line greps per repository and the reader reads one checkout.
- **Stale report.** The only `os-dev-report` on the card names head `8fee4048ce` (51 cases, four unread legs, p3 under Rides, `execution-duties.md` 189 to 183). This head is one commit later (54 cases, five unread legs, p3 close-out, 184 lines). The card carries no report at the head under review. The seat reads this before accepting.
- Author: the PR's `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no named-author note is owed.
- SQL push-down: no data-layer code in the diff. No id materialisation, no in-app join. No finding.
- One security-relevant observation on an implementing file is routed to the seat privately. Its mechanism is not written here; a private follow-up carries it.
- Auto-merge is not armed (`auto_merge` null, the PR is a draft), so this FAIL owes no disarm.

### ④ Design judgment

**M1 (must-fix) — `check-prior-rulings.mjs --paths` decides "hits that cite no ruling" with a two-shape regex, and prints the rule's count outcome on the rule's own worked example.** `surfaceVerdict` (`scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs:990-998`) classes a hit line as citing a ruling only when `RULING_ID_RE` (`:947`) finds `ADR-NNN` or a 9 to 11 digit number on that line; otherwise it prints `命中 N 行,无裁决 id → 写命中数 N` (`:996`, rendered at `:1084`). The rule it serves, `execution-duties.md:13`, says 「本卡与命中所引裁决逐字入区(id+原句)作约束;零命中才写无裁决,命中无裁决写命中数」: whether a hit cites a ruling is a reading of the hit. `dispatch-runbook.md:216-217` gives the canonical case: the grep on `screen-input-contract.ts` hits 「ruling A′」 and the ruling area carries `A′`, its record id and the original sentence. At this head that file cites its rulings as `ruling A′, 2026-09-13` (`:164`), `ruling A+, #31491` (`:67`, `:91`), `by ruling (#30178)` (`:82`), `#17306 ruling A′` (`:263`): by name, date and card number. A `git grep` of the four words over the file returns 22 hit lines, and exactly one carries a shape the regex knows (`:231`, an unrelated `ADR-0114 D2` mention). So on the runbook's own example the reader reports one citing line, and it is not ruling A′; on a surface with no ADR mention it tells the seat to write a count. That is the unsafe direction: a maintainer ruling drops out of the dispatch order while the reader's verdict reads as the rule's own words. The self-test pins the behaviour (`:1944`, "hits with no ruling id are a COUNT"), so the gate is green on it. Fix direction: the verdict line states the reading owed on every hit and never the `写命中数` outcome; an id-shape match may be offered as a hint, not as the classifier. With the cap at `:949` only 12 hits per word are named in the text output, so the line also has to say where the rest are read.

**S1 (should-fix) — `--depth` reaps dead waiter tickets without reporting them.** `mode_depth` (`scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh:2639-2667`) counts through `queue_live`, which deletes every ticket it judges dead (`:735-747`). `mode_status` takes `liveness_snapshot` first for exactly this reason (`:2528-2532`), and the design note above it records why: a dev whose turn ended while waiting left no trace on the surface a seat reads (`:995-1008`). `execution-duties.md:19` now moves the pre-dispatch read from `--status` to `--depth`, so the read a dispatching seat takes before each dispatch deletes that evidence and prints none of it, and a later `--status` cannot show it. The depth number itself is right: live tickets + 1, the holder and parked slots not counted, hold at `LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD` = 2, exit 3 when the probe is unlit. Fix direction: count without pruning, or take the snapshot and print the dead verdicts as `--status` does. No self-test case holds a dead ticket in place across a `--depth` run.

**S2 (should-fix) — a declared path that matches no file reads as the rule's clean verdict.** `premiseReadings` (`scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs:1050-1056`) greps the pathspecs at the revision and `git grep` exits 1 with no output when a pathspec matches nothing, which the caller maps to no hits. A mistyped, moved or renamed path therefore prints `零命中 → 无裁决`. The by-hand grep it replaces fails loudly on a missing path. Zero files read is not zero hits: the reader should name each declared path that matched no file at the revision and withhold the clean verdict for it.

**S3 (should-fix) — `card-pick.mjs` lists cards a seat may not claim, and its footer does not say so.** The reader has no `domain:*` reading: rows print grade, area, type, leg, age and fleet (`scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs:449`), and the self-test pins `--lane` as refused (`:854`). On `main`, a `domain:*` seat's candidate set is its lane (`execution-duties.md:7`), a `repo:objectstack` seat does not claim a cloud card or a security advisory (`SKILL.md:172-174`, `lanes/objectstack.md` 范围), and this diff removes the one phrase that scoped the pick order to 「本车道队列」 (old `execution-duties.md:50`). Every p1 on the board is a `p1 jump` pick whatever lane owns it. The footer promises that an absent leg never reads as a leg that found nothing (`:44-50`, `:144-150`), and lane ownership is not among its five legs. Neither is the second gap the docblock admits at `:34-35`: an area item is ranked p2 before p3 even when the area holds a sub-epic whose child order rule 3 clause ③ makes binding. Fix direction: name both legs in `UNREAD_LEGS` and print the card's `domain:*` on the row.

**S4 (should-fix) — an unread `Blocked-by:` target or parent holds a card under `COMPLETE`, exit 0.** The file's exit contract says 0 means "every read answered" (`scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs:68`). A target row that cannot be read becomes `unresolved` (`:372`) and a parent read that fails becomes `H74_PARENT_UNREADABLE` (`:401`); each adds a reason to the row (`:391`, `:404`) and neither is pushed to `incomplete`. Without `--why` the held card is not printed at all (`:471-473`), so one failed read silently removes the top-ranked card from the picks and the run still ends `card-pick COMPLETE`. The thread read does this correctly (`:381-384`); these two reads should follow it, or the held card should be printed without `--why`.

**S5 (should-fix) — `coordinator.md:27` points at a reader that cannot rank part of what the line orders.** The line orders a batch of candidate rows handed by seats, and `coordinator.md:25` defines a row as 「卡/PR … 续做分支」. `card-pick.mjs` ranks open `pm:queue` issues only (`:319`), drops pull requests (`:326`), and excludes an assigned or `pm:dispatched` card (`:215-218`). For a PR row, a resumed card or a card already claimed, the reader has no rank; the sentence it replaced (「p0/p1 先,余照点名次序」) answered for every row from the row's own grade column, at the same line cost. Fix direction: keep the rule sentence and name the reader as its reading for queue cards.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract):

- N1 — `execution-duties.md` keeps three terms whose definitions this diff removes: 「标签序」 (`:49`, defined on the removed line 53, whose 「无级」 last leg is now stated only in `card-pick.mjs:30-31`), 「开放」 (`:48`, used only by the old line 50) and 「工作项面」 (`:14`, a face of the removed 「三面都查」). 「裁决同罪」 is dropped with no successor.
- N2 — `coordinator.md:17` and `seat-lifecycle.md:89` name the command without `--order`, which the CLI requires (`card-pick.mjs:599`, exit 2).
- N3 — `parseSeat` (`card-pick.mjs:175-178`) refuses a lane containing `#`, so an epic seat's signature lane (`epic:#N`, valid in `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE`) cannot be passed to `--seat`. Its own claim then reads as another seat's; the card is still not a pick.
- N4 — `mode_depth` writes its `printf` formats with literal newlines inside the quotes (`os-verify-lock.sh:2642-2646`, `:2663`), unlike the rest of the file; and on a host with no usable `flock` it prints `depth 1 … go` without the unlocked-mode disclosure `--status` gives.
- N5 — the card-ref face reads `#N` and `owner/repo#N` in the card body and thread only (`check-prior-rulings.mjs:1018-1021`). A GitHub URL names nothing, and a card named by a ruling found in the tree is not followed, where the removed line read 「裁决/卡片点名的每张 issue」. The output does not name the work-item face as unread.
- N6 — `seat-lifecycle.md:89` drops 「无卡点即候选,⛔ 不得报空」, and the reader's most common row, `outside --order`, is not in the vocabulary the line lists.
- N7 — `--order` given as the last argument with no value parses as an empty order (p0 and p1 only) instead of a usage error (`card-pick.mjs:571`, `:579`).

What holds, read against the cited code: `RULE_PHRASES` are the four clauses of NORTH-STAR rule 3 at this head; p0, then p1 from any area, then each `--order` item in turn, then the ungraded leg (`placeCard`, `rankCards`); an epic's children in child order whatever the grade; the same-grade order as `execution-duties.md:52` writes it (non-fleet, then `Bug`, then age) through `h67ReadOrder` and a stable sort; `Blocked-by:` through `blockerTargetsFor` and `blockerResolutionFromRow`, a closed unmerged PR keeping the block as `state-machine.md:28` requires; the claim and release markers through `markerMatches`; every page walked and the count checked against the platform's total; `LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD` held equal to the value the rule line names; the same-day line quoted verbatim from `dispatch-runbook.md:222`.

**VERDICT: FAIL**

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaAqjP52wVTzs99H5G

**L1 delta after L2: ACCEPT** · area fleet-1 · 2026-11-19T12:28Z · head `1bdac164b5` (from `6f40150dd0`, three commits)

- **M1.** `--paths` no longer classifies hits. Each file's hits are printed with the reading they are owed (「逐行读:引裁决 ⇒ id+原句入裁决区;不引 ⇒ 计数」). An id-shape match is only tagged as a hint, and `写命中数` is never printed. When a word passes the cap, the output gives the remaining count and the exact `git grep` to re-run. The count pin is replaced by a fixture shaped like `screen-input-contract.ts`. Ablation: with the regex classifier restored, 2 of 184 cases go red.
- **S1.** `--depth` judges each ticket without pruning, and lists dead tickets as left in place. A self-test case shows a dead ticket still on disk after the run.
- **S2.** A declared path that matches no file is named, and the clean verdict is withheld for it. Ablation: 1 case goes red.
- **S3.** Rows print `domain:*`. The footer names seven legs, adding lane ownership and an area item that holds a sub-epic.
- **S4.** An unread `Blocked-by:` target or parent makes the run incomplete (exit 4) with the gap named, and the held card is printed without `--why`. Ablations on each read turn 1 case red.
- **S5.** `coordinator.md` keeps 「p0/p1 先,余照点名次序」 and names the reader for queue cards.
- **Nits.** N2–N7 are fixed. N1 is partly fixed: 标签序 is defined again with 无级 and the lane scope. 裁决同罪 is not restored, because the line has no room under 120 bytes. The work-item face is named as unread under N5.
- **Card-ref face.** It is scoped to the swept repository. A ref outside the owner is listed by number and not read. A ref to the same owner shows its state and assignees only. Names that are not plain `owner/repo` are rejected.
- **Gates.** Self-tests pass: card-pick 62, check-prior-rulings 184, os-verify-lock all. The ratchet (184/189, 98/99, 51/51), skill-id-lint, governed-prose, self-test-wired and nul-bytes all exit 0. `dispatch-gates`: 82 families accounted for, 76 run and 6 not measured (they need dist). Overlap is clean.
- **Records.** A fresh os-dev-report on this head is #35237 comment 7009075388. The PR body has been refreshed and reads back identical.
- **CI.** At this head: 50 success, 12 skipped, 1 queued.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1bdac164b570843a0b98342ca47dc30b2f5a84ba`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/coordinator.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md + scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs, scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs, scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh, package.json (the `check:pm-prior-rulings` line)

Delta review of PR #35482 (draft, `Part of #35237`): the three commits `6f40150dd0..1bdac164b5` (`1249b29022`, `a2e160a2bd`, `1bdac164b5`), read against the record on `6f40150dd0`. Six files move; `package.json` does not. The merge base is still `6f36818f03`; `main` has since moved to `819c0679a8` and touched none of this PR's paths. Inputs: card #35237 (body and its 5 comments), the PR body, file list and diff, and the check-runs on this head. No reader was run and the live board was not read.

Check-runs on this head at 2026-11-19T12:32Z: all 64 concluded, 51 success, 13 skipped, none failed, none pending. `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (both `check-prior-rulings` and `card-pick` self-tests), `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` (`os-verify-lock.sh --self-test`), `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and both `PR-body guards` are green.

### ① Derived judgments

- No published accept-set and no public surface changes in the delta. Right, as before.
- The delta restores rule sentences the first contraction dropped and leaves the pointers in place: `coordinator.md:27` carries 「p0/p1 先,余照点名次序」 again; `execution-duties.md:47` defines 「标签序」 with its 「无级殿后」 leg and scopes it to 「本车道开放卡」; `seat-lifecycle.md:89-90` carries 「无卡点即候选,⛔ 不得报空」 and one vocabulary that includes `outside --order`. Each is right against the reader it names.
- The readers' internal output changes: `--paths` prints a reading owed and no count outcome; `--depth` names dead tickets and deletes none; `card-pick.mjs` prints `domain:*` on every row, two more unread legs, and a held-card block. None is a published contract.
- The drift pins follow the prose: `DUTIES_PHRASES` and `LIFECYCLE_PHRASES` quote the new lines, and the gate that runs them is green.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged and right: `skip-changeset`, nothing published. `Clause-②: no` holds.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The dev report on the card (comment 7009075388) names this head, `1bdac164b570843a0b98342ca47dc30b2f5a84ba`. Its `open_questions` is empty. This closes the stale-report flag of the previous record.
- Its two deviations (pushed fast-forward from a local alias branch; no `origin/main` merge this round) need no ruling: the branch on the PR is `claude/project-thread-w9aa30`, and `main` has not touched these paths.
- The report's finding map does not mention the self-test case this round deleted (S6 below). The seat reads that before accepting.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no named-author note is owed.
- SQL push-down: no data-layer code in the delta. No finding.
- The security-relevant observation routed privately on the previous head is addressed in this head. Its mechanism stays out of this record; the judgment is with the seat.
- Auto-merge is not armed (`auto_merge` null, the PR is a draft).

### ④ Design judgment

Closed on this head, each read in the tree:

- M1: closed
- S1: closed
- S2: closed
- S3: closed
- S4: closed
- S5: closed

What the tree shows for each. M1: `surfaceVerdict` (`scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs:1035`) no longer classifies a hit; the id regex is a per-line hint (`:968`), every file is listed under the reading owed (`:976`), the only verdict left is the zero-hit one, and past the per-word cap the exact `git grep` is printed. The self-test now runs a fixture shaped like the runbook's worked example and asserts no count outcome. S2: each declared path is checked against the revision's tree (`:1156`); a path that matched no file is named and the clean verdict withheld. S1: `mode_depth` (`scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh:2647`) classifies with `ticket_state`, which only reads, and leaves dead tickets in place and named (`:2684`); two self-test cases hold a dead ticket across `--depth` and then find its verdict in `--status` (`:4446`, `:4449`). S3: `domainOf` (`scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs:205`) is on every row and `UNREAD_LEGS` (`:150`) names lane ownership and the sub-epic inside an area item. S4: an unreadable `Blocked-by:` target (`:409`) and an unreadable parent (`:427`) mark the run incomplete, and the held cards print without `--why` (`:499`). S5: `coordinator.md:27` states the rule and names the reader as its reading for queue cards.

**S6 (should-fix) — the fix round deleted a starred self-test case and names no duplicate.** At `6f40150dd0`, `scripts/pm/check-prior-rulings.mjs:1946-1947` pinned `parseLog`'s day arithmetic: 「⭐ same-day is the UTC day of the commit, an offset date converted」, with a `+08:00` commit that falls on the previous UTC day as its control. The case is gone at this head and nothing replaces it: the only remaining same-day case (`:2134`) feeds one commit stamped `Z` on the same day, so a `parseLog` that took the day from the raw timestamp text would pass. The code itself is unchanged and right (`:1070-1080`); what is lost is the pin on the sentence the reader's docblock and the PR body both state (a commit "dated today (UTC)"). AGENTS.md:144 allows a test to be deleted only when its PR names a duplicate pinning that assertion, and the PR body and the dev report name none: they report 18 cases becoming 29 without saying one was removed. Of the seven case names that left, the other six have successors. The same hunk also narrows the log-argument case (`:2131`) so it no longer asserts that the log runs on the declared paths. Fix direction: restore the UTC case and the pathspec assertion.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract):

- N1 — partly taken: 「标签序」 and 「开放」 have their definitions back. 「工作项面」 (`execution-duties.md:14`) still has no antecedent in the prose, though the reader now names that face as unread, and 「裁决同罪」 has no successor. Left as an accepted deviation or a follow-up card.
- N2, N3, N4, N5, N6, N7 — taken. `--order` is on both pointers; `--seat` reads every signature lane; `mode_depth` uses escaped newlines and discloses unlocked mode; the unread faces are printed under every `--paths` run; the queue-empty vocabulary is whole; `--order` with no value is a usage error.
- N8 — a ref outside the swept repository's owner prints as a bare `#N` (`check-prior-rulings.mjs:1198`), the same spelling as a local card. The state text on the row tells them apart; the repository name is only in the JSON output.

No must-fix. S6 is open on this head, so this record does not clear the head for landing: its fix moves the head and is owed a delta review.
